name: Volume Guard
summary: Bounds on routed trade size and on rolling routed volume, per market and per wallet.
behavior: Before-callbacks deny trades whose deterministic estimate exceeds the configured size.
After-callbacks re-check the amount Pump actually executed and fail the whole transaction if it exceeds the guard.
Rolling window (up to 7 days) for market-wide and per-wallet routed volume.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Counts routed volume only; trades made directly on Pump are invisible to the guard.
